reading: אלהים has no visible holam. The lamed ascender is continuous with its letterhead. The detached marks above belong to the preceding line; there is no independent point belonging to this word.

previous_crop_limitation.reading: Uncertain whether אלהים prints a holam. There is a dark detached mark clipped by the upper image edge near the gap above alef and lamed, but this crop does not let me confidently identify it as a vowel or assign it to a letter. The visible raised stroke on lamed is continuous with its letterhead, not a detached holam.
